biggest_catch: The friend must be a completely new member with no previous Service 1st relationship, and their debit card must make a transaction within 30 days of membership opening - otherwise neither of you gets anything.
catches: Referrer must be 18+ and in good standing; rewards paid by direct deposit only to Service 1st members.
Friend must be a new member with NO previous Service 1st relationship (any previously closed account disqualifies them).
Friend must open a checking account with debit card, have Service 1st digital banking, and the debit card must perform a transaction within 30 days of membership opening.
If either account is closed before the reward is paid, neither party is eligible.
Cap: $50 per referred new member, maximum 6 referred members ($300/year).
Rewards may be reportable as taxable income; offer valid through December 31, 2026; cannot combine with other promotions (except the Checking Bundle).

steps: As a Service 1st member in good standing, refer friends/family to join.
Friend opens a new membership (checking account with debit card + Service 1st digital banking).
Friend's debit card performs a transaction within 30 days of membership opening.
$50 is credited by direct deposit to your share savings account.
timing: $50 credited by direct deposit after the friend's debit card transacts within 30 days of membership opening; accounts must remain open until payment.
when_cash_arrives: $50 credited by direct deposit after the friend's debit card transacts within 30 days of membership opening; accounts must remain open until payment. Roughly a month from the trigger event to cash in hand.
maximize: Trigger the clock early: have your friend complete qualifying activity (direct deposit, debit transactions) in the first days of the window.
Route a real payroll direct deposit (not Zelle/P2P transfers, which most programs exclude) as early as possible - payroll timing is usually the gating step.
If any-amount direct deposit qualifies, a small recurring ACH can trigger it - check the program's 'qualifying deposit' definition first.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: the payout window itself is 3-4 weeks after qualification - there is no expedited track.
